zh: 她当时穿着一件红夹克。
en: She {had on|was wearing|wore} a red jacket.
{Do up|Zip up|Button up|Fasten} your jacket. It's cold.
He {held out|put out|stretched out|extended|offered} his hand to shake mine.

zh: 你的衣服标签露出来了。
那一幕太吓人了，我只好把脸转开。
en: The scene was so scary that I had to {turn away|look away}.
Mind the step or you'll {fall over|trip|fall}.

zh: 请往后退一步，门要关了。
en: Please {step back|stand back|move back} from the doors.

zh: 把夹克拉链拉上，外面冷。
en: {Zip up|Do up} your jacket. It's cold outside.

zh: 昨晚看电影的时候我打起了瞌睡。
en: I {dozed off|nodded off|fell asleep|drifted off} during the movie last night.

zh: 他把烟头掐灭，回到了屋里。
en: He {stubbed out|put out} his cigarette and went back inside.

zh: 我在黑暗中撞到了门上。
en: I {bumped into|walked into|ran into|banged into|hit} the door in the dark.
Excuse me, can I {get by|get past|squeeze past|squeeze by}?

zh: 你能往那边挪一点让我坐下吗？
en: Can you {move over|shift over|budge up|scoot over} a bit so I can sit down?

zh: 转过身来，让我看看后面。
en: {Turn around|Turn round} and let me see the back.
Please {take off|remove} your shoes before you come in.
It's cold outside, {put on|wear} your jacket.

zh: 吃晚饭前我先去洗一洗。
en: I'll just {clean up|wash up|freshen up|get washed} before dinner.
